mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 5-year windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings declines, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for three months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in last month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% for two consecutive months signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for two months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) consistently indicates labor market strength that supports corporate hiring and earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days without specific triggers.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS grows, or Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% annually) triggers central bank tightening and reduces real consumption, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annually, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 90.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 90.0 for two months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
